name: axion-search
description: AXION Search — Cloudflare Pages frontend, Workers API, service bindings, multi-provider meta search and grounded AI summary.

scripts.dev:pages: npx wrangler pages dev ./public --config wrangler.pages.jsonc --service AXION_SEARCH_API=axion-search-api
scripts.deploy:pages: npx wrangler pages deploy ./public --project-name axion-search-site --config wrangler.pages.jsonc
scripts.test: node --check worker/src/index.js && node --check worker/src/search-engine.js && node --check public/sdk/axion-search-sdk.js && node tests/smoke-tests.js
